title: Flail of Ages

sources.title: Elemental Age
markers: | description = Give your main hand weapon a +1 bonus to its {{Attack roll}}s and an additional 1d4 {{DamageType|Acid}}, {{DamageType|Cold}} or {{DamageType|Fire}} damage to its strikes depending on the elemental age embodied.

sources.title: Elements of an Epoch
markers: | description = Depending on what kind of damage this weapon does, it also inflicts: {{Cond|Acid}} condition, {{Cond|Chilled}} condition, or {{Cond|Burning}} condition.

summary: A +1 flail with a choice of Acid, Cold, or Fire weapon enchantment and corresponding conditions.

fields.Elemental Age: Bonus Action once per Long Rest. Choose Acid, Cold, or Fire to give your main-hand weapon +1 to attack rolls and 1d4 of that damage until Long Rest. Extra damage does not apply when thrown.
fields.Elements of an Epoch: Qualifying Acid, Cold, and Fire hits can apply Acid, Chilled, or Burning for 2 turns. Roll a separate DC 13 Constitution save for each qualifying element. Chilled and Burning remove each other.
fields.Stacking: Does not stack with Elemental Weapon, Draconic Elemental Weapon or another Elemental Age. Can stack with Magic Weapon and Elemental Cleaver.
fields.Other weapons: You can equip the flail off-hand with Dual Wielder and enchant the main-hand weapon. The enchantment persists after unequipping the flail.
fields.Base value: 320 gp in standard modes or 480 gp in Honour Mode. Merchant prices vary.

changes: Added native BG3 gameplay use and reviewed pinned source evidence. Reconciled applicable action, condition, and variant details against pinned rules.
